text:
leah_cs: Heads-up — VerdantAI onboarding healthcheck: 95th p90 tail latency spikes on chat generate during peak (9–10am PT). Their baseline is rw-3b and they're eager to reduce costs before renewal touch. Thinking: 1) try int8 quantized variant 2) route <=50ms requests to rw-3b-quant-int8 canary, fallback to rw-3b-compat 3) enable prefix KV caching for repeated prompts. Anyone want to own canary plan?

noah_se: I can own the canary. quick ask: do we have recent perf traces and token-length distribution? will pick canary size after seeing seq len. :+1:

maria_platform: grabbing traces now. FYI from initial look ~60% of requests are <=128 tokens, 30% 128–512, rest long. Canary suggestion: 5% traffic for 48h, then 20% for 24h, monitor latency/p99/error-rate. Also set a cost guardrail threshold.

dan_eng: For quantization: we can run an internal bench for int8 vs int4 delta on RW-3B. Expected perf: int8 ~30–40% cost savings, int4 ~55–65% but higher risk on quality. I'd start int8. Can prepare a small test harness to compare logits divergence on their eval set.

maria_platform: proposed routing rule (can drop into console routes):
```json
{
  \"route_name\": \"verdantai-quant-canary\",
  \"match\": {
    \"client_id\": \"verdantai-prod\",
    \"percent\": 5
  },
  \"primary_model\": \"rw-3b-quant-int8\",
  \"fallback_model\": \"rw-3b-compat\",
  \"slo_ms\": 150,
  \"observability_tags\": [\"cs:verdantai\", \"pilot:quant\"]
}
```

noah_se: perfect. i'll wire up canary and add tracing hooks (span: customer_request) and a quick eval hook that samples 200 requests/day for quality comparison. who should get the daily report?

leah_cs: me + account owner (ara@verdantai.com) + renewals lead. i'll also ask enablement to prep a short doc on expected behavior changes for their support team.

dan_eng: ran quick local bench — int8 latency drop ~18% p50 and ~22% p95 on our T4 cluster, throughput up ~1.4x. will upload full report to the ticket. note: int8 model artifact size reduction ~38% so cache pressure down.

ops-bot: deployment job started: job_id=deploy-7782, canary=5%, models=[rw-3b-quant-int8]. Link: https://deploys.internal/jobs/deploy-7782

noah_se: launched canary. monitoring dashboards pinned to #customer-success ops dashboard. I'll post a short summary after 6 hours.

leah_cs: awesome — thanks team. plan for next steps: 1) monitor 48h, 2) if quality delta < 2% on their eval set, bump to 20% for 24h, 3) if stable, recommend renewal note about unit cost improvement and option to lock quantized model. tagging renewal ops. :rocket:
